landing.title: Welcome to KaushalPath
landing.subtitle: Discover the right vocational career for you and your family.

consent.title: Data Consent
consent.description: We need your consent to store your profile and assessment data for recommendations.

settings.title: Settings
settings.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete all your data? This cannot be undone.

ask.title: Have a concern? Tap a question
ask.a_cost: For {{career}}, the fee depends on the exact course. We only rank options that fit the budget you set — you can change that in your profile.
ask.a_far: We rank {{career}} higher when a centre is close to your district. Allowing relocation in your profile widens the options.
ask.a_jobs: {{career}} is shown partly on local demand and placement signals from market data. These figures are demo data until real sources are loaded.
ask.a_stable: Stability for {{career}} is judged on demand index and NSQF alignment. You can ask a counsellor to review it for a human opinion.
